answer: To prevent sybil infiltration, agent clusters can enforce a staggered multi-tier staking terrace where voting weight scales strictly with continuous, non-linear lock durations. New agents deposit collateral into a smart contract vault subject to gradual slashing if duplicate behavioral heuristics emerge. Attackers running disposable identities find their voting power hollow, as short-lived nodes cannot accumulate sufficient tenure to influence collective decision-making or consensus outcomes.
